BTS World Tour Expected to Boost Hong Kong Hotels

South Korean pop group BTS's upcoming "Arirang World Tour" is projected to significantly benefit Hong Kong's hospitality sector. Hotels in the city anticipate a surge in bookings, mirroring the positive impact experienced in Seoul earlier this year during the group's comeback performances. The tour's arrival in Hong Kong is expected next year.
